title: Premonition of the DC Metro red line fire
place_text: DC Metro red line, Washington DC

tellings.quote: on the 89th day um there was a fire fatal fire on the red line of the metro in DC

plain: A premonition is said to have come true "on the 89th day," when a deadly fire broke out on the red line of the Washington DC subway, the Metro. Luis Elizondo, who once ran a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, tells this about himself, mentioning the physicist Hal Puthoff in connection with it. If true, it would suggest that some people can sense events before they happen.
